script_text: Stop! Pisces, the cosmos is testing your boundaries right now, and you cannot ignore this cosmic signal. Saturn is grinding hard against your 1st House cusp. It demands maturity from you. Meanwhile, the Moon conjuncts Neptune, your ruling planet, in the 5th House. If you are single, this intense energy attracts a serious partner who demands stability, not just fantasy. If you are committed, guard your emotional independence carefully, or old resentments could surface in the 7th House. Career-wise, Venus in the 10th House of Public Reputation rewards your discipline with a tangible financial offer this afternoon. You might finally receive a delayed cash bonus for work completed months ago under heavy pressure. Warning: Do not sign a quick deal promising overnight wealth, or you will pay the price. Follow for tomorrow's reading before this powerful energy shifts again for your Water sign.
